verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair axis for a Git hosting platform, but nothing in the evidence shows Gitea generating AI insights or suggestions from user data inside the product. The official MCP server (gitea-probe-3) lets external agents reach Gitea data, which is an adjacent building block rather than in-product AI. Repository Activity statistics are not AI-generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
